name: Spieljoch
kurzbeschreibung: The family-friendly Erlebnisberg in the Zillertal with panoramic views, climbing park, marble run, and alpine adventures.
beschreibung:
Overview

Mount Spieljoch (1,865 m rising to the Spieljoch summit at 1,920 m) presides as a sunny, family-friendly adventure and panoramic mountain directly over the market town of Fügen in the lower Zillertal valley. Aboard the modern 10-passenger Spieljochbahn monocable gondola, visitors ascend in under ten minutes from the valley floor directly into a vibrant alpine wonderland. Arriving at the mountain terminal reveals sweeping 360-degree vistas stretching across the Zillertal, the Inn Valley, the Rofan Mountains, and the Karwendel massif. Positioned as the premier family adventure hub of the valley, the summit area boasts an expansive water and nature adventure park complete with a timber raft pond, an adrenaline-pumping Flying Fox zip line, barefoot sensory tracks, and Austria's highest-altitude show mine, creating one of the most beloved day trip destinations in Tyrol.

Route & Requirements

Trails around Spieljoch cater to all generations and interests. Families enjoy the gentle barefoot and sensory nature circuit circling the mountain reservoir lake and the scenic Spieljoch chapel (walking time 30 to 45 minutes, easy grade T1, mostly stroller friendly). A fascinating cultural highlight is the hiking descent to the historic Öxltal Show Mine: in roughly 45 minutes from the top station, walkers reach the mine portal where miners extracted copper and iron ore over 400 years ago (guided underground tours equipped with hard hats and headlamps, grade T1/T2). Active mountain hikers can traverse the panoramic ridge to Geolsalm chalet (1 hour, grade T1/T2) or tackle the high-altitude trek across to Mount Kellerjoch or Hochfügen (3 to 4 hours, grade T2/T3). Climbers enjoy the training via ferrata directly adjacent to the mountain station (grade B/C) and an aerial ropes course. Sturdy footwear and sun hats are recommended. Leashed dogs are welcome on all walking trails and ride the cable car.

Visit & Arrival

Rail passengers travel via the Zillertalbahn to Fügen-Hart station, where local shuttle buses connect directly to the Spieljochbahn base terminal in Fügen. Motorists arrive from the Inntal autobahn A12 (exit Wiesing/Zillertal), following the B169 highway 8 kilometers into Fügen. Ample free multi-story parking is available right beside the lower gondola terminal. The Spieljochbahn operates daily from late May through late October between 8:30 AM and 4:30 PM.

Tips

Don't miss a guided tour through the historic Öxltal Show Mine to experience centuries-old subterranean mining heritage (bring a warm fleece, as the tunnels remain a constant 6 °C year-round). Dine on the panoramic deck of the modern "Mountain Loft" restaurant at the mountain station, serving wood-fired stone pizzas and regional Tyrolean specialties.
